title: This Bloody Website
desc: IM FINALLY DONE. It's 1am and for the past week I have been slaving away at making this website, as much as I love developing it I am SO HAPPY im done (for now), I had to work for quite a while to get my terra hours up so i can get that sweet sweet terra shirt :D. But now I have such a cool website that actually displays all the information I could EVER need (and it has tic tac toe, like can it get any better than that) It has been such a good learning experience and ill use all the things ive learned in future sites!
